## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

```{r}
glimpse(penguins)
fivenum(penguins$bill_length_mm)
```

```{r}
penguins |> 
  group_by(species) |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = species, y = bill_length_mm, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Bill Lengths(mm) across Penguin Species",
    x = "Penguin Species",
    y = "Bill Length (mm)"
  )
```
